hints: Write the net volume rate of change $\dfrac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t} = 40\pi - 0.8\pi r$.
Use $V = \dfrac{4}{3}\pi r^3 \implies \dfrac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}r} = 4\pi r^2$ and the chain rule to show $5r^2\dfrac{\mathrm{d}r}{\mathrm{d}t} = 50 - r$.
walkthrough:
Express the net rate of change of the volume of the balloon:
$$\dfrac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t} = \text{Inflow} - \text{Outflow} = 40\pi - 0.8\pi r = \pi(40 - 0.8r)$$

State the volume of a sphere of radius $r$ and differentiate with respect to $r$:
$$V = \dfrac{4}{3}\pi r^3 \implies \dfrac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}r} = 4\pi r^2$$

Connect the derivatives using the chain rule:
$$\dfrac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t} = \dfrac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}r} \cdot \dfrac{\mathrm{d}r}{\mathrm{d}t} \implies 4\pi r^2\dfrac{\mathrm{d}r}{\mathrm{d}t} = \pi(40 - 0.8r)$$

ai_rubric.Differential-Equation Modelling: States $dV/dt = 40\pi - 0.8\pi r$ (B1). Differentiates volume to get $dV/dr = 4\pi r^2$ (B1). Applies chain rule to obtain $5r^2 dr/dt = 50 - r$ (B1).

hints: Determine the linear quotient $-5r - 250$ and constant remainder $12500$.
walkthrough:
Perform algebraic long division of $5r^2$ by $(50 - r) = -r + 50$:
1. First term of quotient: $\dfrac{5r^2}{-r} = -5r$.
   Multiply and subtract:
   $$5r^2 - (-5r)(-r + 50) = 5r^2 - (5r^2 - 250r) = 250r$$

2. Second term of quotient: $\dfrac{250r}{-r} = -250$.
   Multiply and subtract:
   $$250r - (-250)(-r + 50) = 250r - (250r - 12500) = 12500$$

Combine terms to express as quotient and remainder:
$$\dfrac{5r^2}{50 - r} = -5r - 250 + \dfrac{12500}{50 - r}$$

ai_rubric.Polynomial Division and Remainder Condit: Commences division to obtain quotient $-5r \pm 250$ (M1). Obtains quotient $-5r - 250$ (A1). Obtains remainder $12500$ (A1).

hints: Separate variables in the differential equation: $\int \dfrac{5r^2}{50 - r}\,\mathrm{d}r = \int 1\,\mathrm{d}t$.
Substitute the division result from part (b), integrate term by term, and apply $r = 0$ at $t = 0$ to find the constant.
walkthrough:
Substitute the partial fraction/division expression from part (b):
$$\int \left(-5r - 250 + \dfrac{12500}{50 - r}\right)\,\mathrm{d}r = \int 1\,\mathrm{d}t$$

Integrate each term with respect to $r$:
$$\int -5r\,\mathrm{d}r = -\dfrac{5}{2}r^2$$
$$\int -250\,\mathrm{d}r = -250r$$
$$\int \dfrac{12500}{50 - r}\,\mathrm{d}r = -12500\ln(50 - r)$$

Integrate the right-hand side and include the constant of integration:
$$-\dfrac{5}{2}r^2 - 250r - 12500\ln(50 - r) + C = t$$

Substitute $C$ to state $t$ explicitly in terms of $r$:
$$t = -\dfrac{5}{2}r^2 - 250r - 12500\ln(50 - r) + 12500\ln 50$$
$$\left(\text{or } t = -\dfrac{5}{2}r^2 - 250r + 12500\ln\left(\dfrac{50}{50 - r}\right)\right)$$

ai_rubric.Solving Separable Differential Equations: Separates variables correctly (B1). Integrates right-hand side to $t$ (DB1). Integrates polynomial and log terms correctly (M1A1). Uses initial condition $t = 0, r = 0$ to find $C$ (M1). Obtains $t = -\frac{5}{2}r^2 - 250r - 12500\ln(50-r) + 12500\ln 50$ (A1).
